disclaimer.note: Validation uses simplified gameplay assumptions chosen for learning and balance. They are not NASA engineering standards or real mission requirements.

descriptions.massMarginFraction: Keep 10% of launch capacity free for mass growth.
descriptions.budgetReserveFraction: Keep 10% of the budget as a cost reserve.
descriptions.powerMarginFraction: Daytime generation should exceed demand by 10%.
descriptions.lunarNightHours: Lunar night length used by the game (about 14.75 Earth days).
descriptions.survivalBusLoadFraction: At night the bus runs at 50% load; thermal and battery loads stay on; other systems sleep.
descriptions.batteryUsableFraction: Only 80% of rated battery capacity is usable.
descriptions.energyMarginFraction: Usable storage should exceed the night energy need by 10%.
descriptions.propellantMarginFraction: Carry 10% more propellant than the transfer requires.
descriptions.relayContactHoursPerDay: The relay orbiter is in view 8 hours per day.
descriptions.commsMarginFraction: Downlink capacity should exceed daily data generation by 20%.
descriptions.relayOutageDays: Onboard storage must buffer 2 days of data during relay outages.
descriptions.constructionWorkDays: Antenna deployment takes 60 robot-days of work, shared across robotic units.
descriptions.maxTransferFraction: Transfers longer than 10% of mission duration eat into operations time.
descriptions.scheduleMarginFraction: The timeline should leave 10% of mission duration as schedule margin.
